name: typst-document-generator
description: Opinionated Typst document templates as a Claude Code plugin. Ships six seed templates (personal, public, business, client-confidential, personal-confidential, briefing) with IBM Plex Sans typography and shared header/footer conventions. Identity and templates live in a user data store at ~/.claude/plugins-data/typst-document-generator/, populated via an interactive onboarding skill — no personal data is baked into the plugin.
